command: SELECT Timestamp, ResourceAttributes['host.name'] AS host, ResourceAttributes['container.name'] AS container, Body FROM external.otel_logs WHERE ResourceAttributes['network']='glamsterdam-msf-2' AND ResourceAttributes['container.name'] IN ('execution','beacon','validator') AND Timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-12 22:24:13') AND Timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-12 23:24:13') AND match(Body,'OutOfMemoryError|Terminating due|FATAL|panic:|state root mismatch|INVALID_PAYLOAD') ORDER BY Timestamp ASC LIMIT 100
